name: ludoteca
description: Cross-store game library viewer for Steam, GOG and Epic.
author: Eduard Dubau

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ludoteca/core && npm run build -w @ludoteca/ui
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui,electron -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @ludoteca/ui" "npm run dev -w @ludoteca/electron"
